conflict_resolutions.FULL_AND_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: Section 2 of EO 14099 reads, in the Federal Register text, that EO 14042 and EO 14043 are revoked, with no limitation to any part. The partial reading came from the order's mention of agency policies; that sentence is a consequence of the whole revocation, not a limit on it.
conflict_resolutions.WHOLE_END_ACTOR_DISAGREEMENT: Two orders revoke EO 14042. EO 14099 is first in time and effective earlier (May 12, 2023), so it is the actor of the first end; EO 14174 (January 21, 2025) is recorded as a later event.
conflict_resolutions.WHOLE_END_DATE_DISAGREEMENT: The 2023-05-09 date is the signing date of EO 14099 as read by the current-law lead; section 3 of EO 14099 makes the revocation effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May 12, 2023, so the end is May 12, 2023. The 2025-01-21 date is EO 14174, a second revocation of an order already revoked, recorded as a later event.

research_rationale:
EO 14042 required a contract clause on COVID-19 safety protocols for federal contractors and set agency, task-force and Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council steps with dates such as October 8, 2021 and October 15, 2021; those dates are deadlines or effective dates for performance, not ends. EO 14099 of May 9, 2023, held in its Federal Register text (88 FR 30891), revoked the order in section 2 and made the revocation effective at 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time on May 12, 2023 in section 3; EO 14174 of January 21, 2025 revoked it again. The first end is May 12, 2023. The dossier's conflicts (a 2023-05-09 date from current-law, the 2025-01-21 revocation, and a whole-versus-partial reading) are resolved in the conflict resolutions.

savings.reason: Section 2 of EO 14099 provides that agency policies adopted to implement EO 14042 and premised on it no longer may be enforced and shall be rescinded consistent with applicable law, and section 4(a) only preserves agency authority granted by law. No continuing independent command or accrued right under EO 14042 is preserved in the held texts.
